repo_notes.content: What raft-kv is: a from-scratch Raft consensus engine with a replicated KV store, HTTP transport, Docker/AWS deployment. Architecture map and links to child pages

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What raft-kv is: a from-scratch Raft consensus engine with a replicated KV store, HTTP transport, Docker/AWS deployment. Architecture map and links to child pages.

pages.title: Getting Started & Local Cluster
pages.purpose: Build, run 5-node local cluster with scripts/start_local.sh and stop_local.sh, ports, data dirs, health checks.

pages.title: Server Entrypoint & Configuration
pages.purpose: cmd/server/main.go wiring: env vars (NODE_ID, PEERS, CLIENT_ADDRS, DATA_DIR, listen addrs), component construction order.

pages.title: Raft Consensus Engine
pages.purpose: Overview of internal/raft: state machine roles, interfaces, links to election/replication, persistence, RPC pages.

pages.title: Core Types and Interfaces
pages.purpose: LogEntry, Command, ApplyMsg, Transport/Persister interfaces, Node struct and Status().

pages.title: Leader Election and Log Replication
pages.purpose: Election timers, term handling, no-op on election, AppendEntries loop, nextIndex/matchIndex, commit advancement, fast conflict backtracking, in-flight RPC guard.

pages.title: RPC Message Formats
pages.purpose: RequestVote/AppendEntries request and reply structs and their semantics.

pages.title: Persistence and WAL Recovery
pages.purpose: Persister: state.json atomic writes, append-only wal.log, Recover, TruncateAndReplace, torn-write handling.

pages.title: Key-Value Store Layer
pages.purpose: Overview of internal/kv replicated state machine and client API; links to children.

pages.title: Store: Replicated State Machine
pages.purpose: Store.Run apply loop, propose/pending index map, ProposeTimeout, ErrNotLeader, local read semantics.

pages.title: Client HTTP API
pages.purpose: Endpoints /kv/put, /kv/get, /kv/delete, /status; JSON shapes, 421 leader redirect.

pages.title: Transport Layer
pages.purpose: Overview of internal/transport: HTTP Raft RPC transport and admin fault-injection API.

pages.title: HTTP Raft Transport
pages.purpose: Implementation of raft.Transport over HTTP, peer addressing, serialization, timeouts.

pages.title: Admin Fault-Injection API
pages.purpose: /admin/* endpoints for drops, delays, partitions on a live node.

pages.title: Testing and Fault Injection
pages.purpose: Overview of test strategy: in-memory fake network harness, failure-mode tests, live cluster scripts.

pages.title: Fake Network and Cluster Harness
pages.purpose: fake_network_test.go and cluster_test.go: drop rates, delays, partitions, crash/restart helpers.

pages.title: Failure-Mode Test Suite
pages.purpose: Election, replication, crash, restart recovery, partition, RPC loss/delay tests.

pages.title: Live Cluster Fault Scripts
pages.purpose: scripts/fault_injection.sh and docker_crash_restart.sh against running clusters.

pages.title: Deployment
pages.purpose: Overview of container build and cluster deployment paths; links to Docker and AWS pages.

pages.title: Docker Image and Compose Cluster
pages.purpose: Multi-stage Dockerfile, docker-compose 5-node topology, volumes, raftnet network.

pages.title: AWS EC2 Deployment
pages.purpose: Instance topology, security groups, deploy.sh SSH orchestration, failure-domain tradeoffs.

pages.title: Image Distribution via ECR
pages.purpose: push_to_ecr.sh: repo creation, login, build/tag/push, pulling on EC2.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of Raft and repo-specific terms (term, quorum, WAL, torn write, ApplyMsg, ErrNotLeader, LeaderHint, no-op on election, ConflictIndex, in-flight RPC guard, PEERS, CLIENT_ADDRS, raftnet, etc.) with file pointers.
